status: Exploratory side experiment; original results unchanged

method.third_channel: ETD or SE, treated as the third detector at the user's direction
method.registration: No registration or resampling; matched pixel grids assumed, separate alignment audit
method.clustering: Three KMeans intensity classes; per-image channel z-scores; 100000 sampled pixels; BSE Multi-Otsu initial centres; seed42; n_init1
method.downstream: Same 14 saved physical fields, including the separate heuristic Inlens median CBD allocation
method.silicon: Bright phase identified as silicon by the user; intensity-derived boundaries still require validation
method.agreement: Mask IoU, Dice and changed-pixel fractions measure agreement, not accuracy against ground truth
method.test_labels: Not used in segmentation, measurement or settings
